problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must allocate shipments into identical cargo pods for interstellar transport. The manifest includes:

* Component Alpha: mass 62 units
* Component Beta: mass 53 units
* Component Gamma: mass 31 units
* Component Delta: mass 30 units
* Component Epsilon: mass 30 units
* Component Zeta: mass 39 units
* Component Eta: mass 46 units
* Component Theta: mass 43 units
* Component Iota: mass 38 units
* Component Kappa: mass 41 units
* Component Lambda: mass 37 units
* Component Mu: mass 61 units
* Component Nu: mass 60 units
* Component Xi: mass 38 units
* Component Omicron: mass 47 units
* Component Pi: mass 46 units
* Component Rho: mass 38 units
* Component Sigma: mass 32 units
* Component Tau: mass 41 units
* Component Upsilon: mass 52 units
* Component Phi: mass 50 units
* Component Chi: mass 42 units
* Component Psi: mass 70 units
* Component Omega: mass 36 units
* Component Ares: mass 62 units
* Component Boreas: mass 61 units
* Component Ceres: mass 39 units
* Component Draco: mass 70 units
* Component Echo: mass 46 units

Each cargo pod has a maximum load capacity of 100 mass units. The objective is to consolidate all listed components utilizing the minimal number of pods, ensuring each component is assigned to precisely one pod and that the cumulative mass within any pod does not surpass its designated limit.
